description: A standard carousel request must produce one slide per proof point plus a closing roof-line slide, and a Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest whose header and row count match the slide deck exactly.

proof_points: any reconciliation variance treated as a Severity-1 incident

rubric.criterion: Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest shape is valid
rubric.condition: The canva_bulk_create_csv field header row equals the exact string slide_number,headline,subhead,image_ref,brand_template_id and its data-row count equals the slide count.

rubric.criterion: Roof line closes the final slide
rubric.condition: The last slide's headline field equals exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.
The output contains the exact string Finance-grade trust, matching the pillar supplied in the input.

notes: AC-12 golden task. This task's own id/description carries the literal substring csv, anchoring the Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest fixture-shape rule from prompt.md.
